name: Talal of Jordan

legacy: The country sought independence in 1946, and the Emirate became the Hashemite Kingdom of this person

checks.lead: Talal  (né Talal bin Abdullah al-Hashimi; 26 February 1909 – 7 July 1972) was King of Jordan from the assassination of his father King Abdullah I in 1951, until his forced abdication in 1952. As a member of the Hashemite dynasty, the royal family of Jordan since 1921, Talal was a 39th-generation direct descendant of Muhammad.
